selector: constrained_mass: per layer, restrict to the safest floor(q*511) slots by redundancy (descending), then take the top_t by attention mass within that candidate set.

dose_response._definition: TOP_T=32 held fixed; only the constraint strength q moves (1.00 = the incumbent tfidf control, then 0.75 / 0.50 / 0.25). A monotone degradation as q tightens, tracking the realised MT routing mass, is the dose-response form of MECH-INFOGATE's log(mass) -> MT relationship (Pearson -0.877 over its six arms).

pooled_with_MECH_INFOGATE._definition: MECH-INFOGATE's six arms plus this bundle's four new selectors, on the identical axes and the identical control.

predicted_vs_realised_mass._definition: PREDICTED = the selector scored offline on the UNTOUCHED Phase-1 cartridge with DIAG-IMPORTANCE's doc-0 eval geometry (research_loop/results/MECH-CONSTRAINED/sanity_mech009.py). REALISED = the same two axes recomputed from the run's own 16 saved per-document masks (am_doc_*.pt), i.e. after the redundancy scores drift with the live cache and the union of written slots grows. The ratio is the systematic optimism of any doc-0 projection, and it is why DIAG-IMPORTANCE's own extrapolation over-promised.

constraint_binding_check._definition: Document-0 direct check that the constraint actually bound: fraction of each layer's selected slots that lie inside the redundancy-safest 383 (q=0.75) of 511.
